changeSet.author: dimopoulosc
changeSet.comment: Add First invitation date column to compliant entity table
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE "compliant_entity" ADD COLUMN "first_invitation_date" TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NULL; COMMENT ON COLUMN "compliant_entity"."first_invitation_date" IS 'Date that first invitation for account claim was sent to the account.';

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE "compliant_entity" DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS "first_invitation_date";

changeSet.author: dimopoulosc
changeSet.comment: Add invitation required column to mets account contacts.
changeSet.sql: alter table mets_account_contact add column if not exists invitation_required boolean default false;

rollback.sql: alter table mets_account_contact drop column if exists invitation_required;
